@@ Adrenal Concentration
@stat: Pr
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for achieving a special +25 bonus activity
 attempted using concentration and the focusing of reserves. If the user
 makes a successful static maneuver, +25 is added any such activity the next
 round. However, this static maneuver 75% of the user’s activity the round
 it is attempted.

@@ Adrenal Landing
@stat: Ag
@description:
 With a successful static maneuver, a character may decrease severity of a
 fall by his skill rank bonus times one foot. For example, character’s skill
 rank bonus was +60, a 100' fall would be treated fall. The severity of a
 fall can never be reduced below that of (requiring a roll on the Fall/Crush
 Attack Table with a +1 modification). A 20% activity action is required the
 round after the fall (assuming alive and conscious). This is the
 “recuperation” round.

@@ Adrenal Leaping
@stat: St
@description:
 This allows the character to automatically increase the distance
 successfully leap from either a standing or a running start. The M/M T–4.1
 can be used, with the skill bonus being added. A 100% indicate a normal
 leap and results above that a longer jump. This requires taking a 20%
 activity action in a “preparation round” immediately prior to the use of
 this skill.

@@ Adrenal Quickdraw
@stat: Ag
@description:
 Bonus for drawing your weapon with 0% activity. Success indicates you have
 your weapon ready and failure indicates you take the 20% activity action
 for drawing your weapon. This skill does against the one adrenal move every
 other round limit. It must be oped separately for each type of weapon
 (1-handed edge, 1-handed crushing, 2-handed, thrown, etc.).

@@ Adrenal Speed
@stat: Qu
@description:
 This allows a character to move at twice normal speed (as if and thus
 increase his activity for one round (see Section 18.2.6). This requires
 taking a 20% activity action in a “preparation round” immediately prior to
 the use of this skill.

@@ Adrenal Stabilization
@stat: SD
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for keeping oneself alive after injured. This
 skill puts your body into a near death condition (coma) 1 day/round before
 death. (Rounds before death is obtained from description of the critical
 strike taken). Due to the slowing down body’s metabolic rate, you will
 appear to be dead to all but the closest scrutiny (-75 from other’s
 perception). If you fail to make a successful static maneuver, you
 immediately into a coma but you still die at the appointed time. You may be
 awakened from this state by one or more of the following: Within 1 hour of
 the time or an Awaken spell or vigorous physical disturbance lasting than 3
 minutes. If you receive a critical that kills instantly, this skill have no
 effect. Certain types of damage may make it impossible to use this skill
 massive brain damage, head being completely ripped off or destroyed, body
 dissolving in acid, heart being ripped out of chest, etc.). Note: skill
 should only be available under unusual circumstances (e.g., exotic monastic
 order, fanatic assassin training, etc.) Routine: +30 Practicing

@@ Adrenal Strength
@stat: St
@description:
 This skill gives a character a +10 modification on his OB and the number of
 concussion hits that he delivers. This skill requires a 20% activity action
 in a “preparation round” immediately prior to of this skill.

-26 down | Spectacular Failure | -25% | 1.5u | -20 | What were you thinking? Your feeble attempt at focus has actually created a mental block which causes you to operate at a -30 modification (non-cumulative) to this skill until you achieve a result of Absolute Success on this table. In addition, you are stunned for two rounds as you contemplate your failure.
-25 — 04 | Absolute Failure | 0% | specialu | -25 | Surely you jest. I hope this wasn’t a preparation round, because you get no benefits, and you lose 30% activity next round.
05 — 75 | Failure | 0% | 1.0u | -5 | You fail to summon the inner focus necessary for this feat, and receive no benefit or effects from your attempt. Thanks for playing.
UM 66 | Unusual Event | | | | special • special • +0 As you begin to summon your focus, you suddenly notice an unfamiliar darkness within yourself. Some influence has taken root in you, and is spreading. Your odd concentration enables you to purge it as with a successful Cleansing Trance static maneuver (along with any other influences that may be affected by a Cleansing Trance static maneuver). However, your original maneuver fails, and you have only 20% activity remaining this round.
76 — 90 | Partial Success | 30% | 0.5u | +0 | You are distracted at the critical moment. If not in combat, you may abort your attempt and try again. Perhaps you should switch to decaff.
UM 100 | Unusual Success | 110% | 1.0u | +10 | Wow! You not only succeed, but you have tapped into a reservoir of strength within yourself. You will operate at +20 (non-cumulative) on this table until you receive a result of Absolute Failure or Spectacular Failure.
91 — 110 | Near Success | 80% | 1.0u | +10 | If not in combat, you may immediately make another roll at +10 to achieve full concentration. Otherwise, it’s tough noogies, friend.
111 — 175 | Success | 100% | 1.0u | +20 | You are a paragon of self-control. Now maybe you’ll stay out of the cookie jar.
176 up | Absolute Success | 120% | 0.1u | +30 | You may attempt this skill again next round without preparation (i.e., you may operate at 100% activity this round and still use this skill next round). For every three consecutive rounds of “preparation” using 100% activity gives a +10 modification to the Self Control static maneuver (to a maximum modification of +50).
